hints: Check the bottom numbers first. Are they the same?
Both bottoms are 8, so the bottom stays 8. Only the tops are added.
Add the tops, 3 + 2, and write the sum over 8.

solution.methodName: Same bottom: add the tops, keep the bottom

steps.why: You can add fractions straight away only when the pieces are the same size. Here both are eighths.
3 eighths plus 2 eighths is 5 eighths, just like 3 mangoes plus 2 mangoes is 5 mangoes.
Adding does not change the size of each piece, so the bottom stays 8.

trapNotes.5/16: This adds the bottoms too (8 + 8 = 16). Keep the bottom the same and add only the tops.
trapNotes.6/8: This multiplies the tops (3 × 2 = 6). The sign is +, so add the tops.
trapNotes.1/8: This subtracts the tops (3 − 2 = 1). The sign is +, so add the tops.
